decisions.decision: Do the whole task now on main in tantra-redesign. (1) Run a reference scan (grep every .webp under app/public/guides against app/src/content/guides and the playbook). Wire in an orphan only if it is the missing image for an existing step that has none. Delete the rest, including s2-tantra-pro-funnel/08, s4-webinar/10 and s1-ads/05. (2) Crop s4-webinar 12 and 16 and the wide s1-blog captures from the existing source images to the region the step is about, using app/scripts/shots/recrop.json, so each renders at least 100 px tall at 390. (3) Crop the search box out of s1-blog 07 and s1-social 06. Don't recapture, because that needs signed-in accounts (T-115). (4) Capture real product screenshots of our local centre, funnel pages and Tantra demo for every Day 1 and Day 3 step in playbook-parts/d1.html and d3.html, and size them with shot-size.ts and shots.css. (5) Run measure.mjs, probe-screenshots, probe-headings and the impeccable detector, check 390 and 1440, commit, push, and mark all 8 ids fixed in AUDIT.md with the commit SHA. Then move the task to review.
decisions.why: Every step can be done locally. The spec allows deleting or cropping instead of recapturing. Day 1 and Day 3 shots can come from our own product. The orchestrator-autonomy rule (2026-10-09) and the Lane C handoff (shot-size system, recrop.json) say how. Recaptures that need a sign-in go through T-115, so they don't block this task.
